name: Any.do
tagline: Task and calendar planner with AI daily planning assistant
painPoints: Daily planning AI is a scheduled prompt, not truly proactive
Email integration is limited and not automatic
Premium features like calendar view and color tags require paid plan
AI assistant features are shallow compared to full AI agents
Sync issues reported across platforms by long-term users
metaDescription: Looking for an Any.do alternative? GAIA is source-available AI that triages email, manages tasks, and runs workflows across your tools. Free tier included.
whyPeopleLook: Any.do has been ahead of competitors in adding an AI planning layer to task management, but the implementation remains surface-level. The daily planning assistant prompts you to review your day each morning, but it does not read your email, does not know about meeting changes, and cannot take actions automatically. Users who want an AI that genuinely manages their day — not just asks them to review a list — look beyond Any.do.
gaiaReplaces: Truly proactive daily planning based on real email and calendar data
Automatic task creation from Gmail without manual entry
Calendar-aware prioritization that adjusts as meetings change
Follow-up reminders generated from email context
Cross-tool intelligence connecting tasks, email, and calendar
gaiaAdvantages: Proactive by design: surfaces tasks and alerts without a daily prompt
Email-native task creation requires zero manual task entry
Persistent memory connects context across sessions and tools
Source-available and self-hostable for data privacy
Tool integrations far beyond Any.do's limited connector set
migrationSteps: Export tasks from Any.do via account settings
Import to GAIA's task manager or connected Todoist
Connect Gmail and Google Calendar for automatic data collection
Enable GAIA's proactive morning briefing to replace Any.do's daily planner

faqs.question: Is GAIA's AI planning genuinely smarter than Any.do's?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA's planning is based on real-time data from your Gmail and Google Calendar, not a prompted list review. It surfaces relevant information proactively based on what is actually happening in your workflow.

faqs.question: Does GAIA have a daily planning session like Any.do's Morning feature?
faqs.answer: GAIA provides a proactive daily briefing that summarizes your email, upcoming calendar events, and priority tasks — similar in concept to Any.do's Morning review but driven by live data rather than a manual prompt.

faqs.question: Can GAIA sync across all platforms like Any.do?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA has web, desktop, mobile, and bot interfaces. Data syncs in real time across all your devices.

faqs.question: Is GAIA cheaper than Any.do Premium?
faqs.answer: Any.do Premium is a paid plan. GAIA Pro is ${{PRO_MONTHLY_PRICE}}/month but includes email management, calendar integration, memory, Deep integrations, and workflow automation. Self-hosted GAIA is free for non-commercial use (plus your own model API costs).
